intent: A client-side SQLite subclass that forwards every read/write to a BedrockTester's server as a Query command instead of touching a local DB file, so HC-Tree-mode tests can still use SQLite-shaped call sites.

objects.name: RemoteSQLite
objects.role: overrides SQLite's read/write/writeIdempotent family to serialize each call into a Query command sent via the owning BedrockTester

objects.name: RemoteSQLite::_runRemoteQuery
objects.role: builds and sends the Query command with bound parameters as sql-param-<name> headers, shared by all public overrides

location_fit.note: Fits; test-only infrastructure paired with BedrockTester.

naming_quality.note: Consistent with the SQLite base class's naming and repo convention (_-prefixed private member/helper).
